prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: Silent Storm clothing diffuse UV texture atlas.
Input image: the supplied texture, which is a faithful nearest-neighbor 4x enlargement of the original; this enlargement is just a reference to make tiny shapes visible is the sole edit target. Reconstruct this exact texture in HD.
Primary request: Perform conservative faithful fine-detail reconstruction and remove low-resolution blur while faithfully preserving original art and UV layout. Output ONLY the flat texture atlas, with the same FULL canvas aspect ratio 1:1 square, target1024x1024.
Materials and source layout: Dark gray-green German uniform jacket cloth with dark leather straps and small original fasteners. In the TOP third, preserve the full-width shoulder/back strip, its two rectangular flap panels and exact seams; beneath it is an opaque BLACK horizontal void. The LOWER jacket front has a center vertical button line and two thin leather straps, existing folds, and irregular black arm/neck UV voids at the bottom. Preserve exact number of original buttons and fasteners, their positions and scale.
Spatial invariants: LOCK the full image canvas and every UV island boundary to its exact normalized position. Preserve all folds and baked shadows in place and at original scale, every seam, original fastener count, stitching frequency, fabric panels, belts, straps, button locations, black padding and irregular cutouts. DO NOT crop, add margins, repack, enlarge islands, zoom or move regions. Black empty space remains opaque black. Fully opaque RGB output.
Detail: Add only subtle fine material variation inside existing material areas. All source form edges remain at their exact input image coordinates; keep pattern frequency fine and original material colors. Existing metal hardware stays the same small size and count. Preserve original dark lighting and exposure; brightness is matched numerically later.
Avoid: new pockets, straps, buttons, buckles, seams, badges, insignia, logos, symbols, text, weapons, objects, embossed decorations, zippers, new damage, modern fabric patterns or gross weave, render lighting, model/mannequin, background scene, comparison layout. Do not interpret dark UV voids as garments to fill. Keep the historical source game style. 
Critical faithful reconstruction: Do not reinterpret ambiguous details as new recognizable hardware. Keep low-contrast ambiguous forms as the same forms and shades. The top two rectangular flaps have only the original indistinct small painted fasteners; do not turn them into bright chrome rivets. The tiny central square in the black horizontal gap is not a large circular snap. All narrow straps and their original dark buckles retain exact size; do not add shiny rivets or rivet rows.
reference_recipe: Original full UV canvas enlarged 4x by nearest neighbor only to expose small shapes to the built-in image editor; no crop, registration, rotation, island rearrangement or interpolation substituted for generation.
